PROC SQL;/*BASE COMPARA SIN CONTRAGENTES ACUMULADO ANUAL, SIN BALANCES*/

SELECT 	T2.AÑO_ACUM AS AÑO,T2.TRIM_ACUM AS TRIM,(substr(PUT(t2.AÑO_ACUM,CHAR4.),3,2) ||"."|| PUT(t2.TRIM_ACUM,CHAR1.)) AS PERIODO,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SI_SCN,t1.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN_N1,T1.N_SCN_N1,
sum(t1.DATO) AS DATO,sum(t1.ANTERIOR) AS ANTERIOR,sum(t1.NUEVA) AS NUEVA,sum(t1.DELTA) AS DELTA	,
FROM COMPARA_SC T1,TABLAS.TIEMPO T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM and t1.c_cuenta not in ('Bce Final','Bce Inicio') and VERSION NOT IN ('DELTA')
DATA pib_ac;SET pib_a_ac pib_n_ac;run;/*junta bases pib acumulado*/

PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE COMPARA_SC_PIB AS /*GENERA BASE A PIB SIN CONTRAGENTE VERSION NUEVA Y ANTERIOR*/
SELECT T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, T1.PERIODO,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SI_SCN,t1.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN_N1,T1.N_SCN_N1,T1.DATO/T2.DATO*100 AS DATO, t1.ANTERIOR/T2.DATO*100 AS ANTERIOR,
FROM COMPARA_SC_ACUM T1,PIB_AC T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.VERSION=T2.VERSION;
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE COMPARA_SC_D AS /*CALCULA DELTA EN TÉRMINOS DEL PIB*/
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VERSION='ANTERIOR' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,SUM(CASE WHEN T1.VERSION='ANTERIOR' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DELTA
FROM COMPARA_SC_PIB T1 GROUP BY T1.AÑO,T1.TRIM, T1.PERIODO,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SI_SCN,t1.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN_N1,T1.N_SCN_N1;
PROC SQL;CREATE TABLE COMPARA_SC_D_2 AS SELECT * FROM COMPARA_SC_D T1,PERIODOS_ANT T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM;QUIT;
